observed_surface: National classifieds portal with sale, rent, commercial, new projects, map search, valuation, broker offices, and professional categories.
observed_strength: Broad supply, strong user habit, broad category coverage, and linked service surfaces.
visible_gap_or_limit: General marketplace breadth makes trust and project depth uneven; not every project gets a decision-grade experience.
nadlan_response: Do not fight with a thin copy of classifieds. Build verified project pages, trust gates, clean category hubs, and lead routing around real supply.

observed_surface: New-project marketplace with builder lists, regional project categories, and large developer coverage.
observed_strength: Strong contractor-facing inventory and project discovery surface.
visible_gap_or_limit: The surface is strong, so NadLan cannot compete with a simple project card. It needs deeper unit decision tools, asset truth, foreign-buyer flow, and measurable lead value.
nadlan_response: Make projects the primary monetization beachhead: 3D journey, unit comparison, verified assets, financing path, and contractor dashboard.

observed_surface: Regional new-project page describing virtual tour, real window view, data tools, project comparison, and apartment matching.
observed_strength: Confirms the competitive bar for project pages includes immersive and data-led features, not just text.
visible_gap_or_limit: This raises the minimum standard for NadLan showroom and comparison work.
nadlan_response: NadLan project pages must include real asset state, unit views, comparison, source gates, and screenshot proof before contractor sales use.

observed_surface: National for-sale index with tens of thousands of listings, prices, city links, private/agent/project mixing, and pagination.
observed_strength: Strong inventory density and local page coverage.
visible_gap_or_limit: Inventory scale is a moat. NadLan should not index city pages without supply or a strong honest empty state.
nadlan_response: Use supply gates for buy/rent pages. Build city pages only where there is inventory, data, or a unique project/trust layer.

observed_surface: New projects and apartment projects index with national and city project counts and filters.
observed_strength: Strong project index and city project pages.
visible_gap_or_limit: Competes directly for new-project discovery. Plain project pages will not be enough.
nadlan_response: Position NadLan around decision confidence: verified project data, view/floor/interior path, financing, professionals, and foreign investor concierge.

observed_surface: Map-led real-estate search with drawing on map, saved lists, notes, filters, and mortgage calculation around listings.
observed_strength: Clear map-first product angle and practical search workflow.
visible_gap_or_limit: Search result pages can be thin or empty when supply is missing; map utility alone does not create full trust.
nadlan_response: Use map interaction where it helps, but connect it to unit truth, surroundings, transit, project lead capture, and content ownership.

observed_surface: Buy search page with advanced filters, image-only filter, virtual-tour filter, and draw-on-map interaction.
observed_strength: Good filter vocabulary for buyer UX and map interactions.
visible_gap_or_limit: Observed page can show zero results for generic route, so indexation must be supply-gated.
nadlan_response: Use filter taxonomy as UX input, but noindex thin filter states and build approved canonical city/category pages only.

observed_surface: Project pages describe renders, apartment plans, tours, video, interactive map layers, points of interest, transactions, air quality, socio-economic and crime data.
observed_strength: This is the closest product benchmark for project depth and surrounding-area data.
visible_gap_or_limit: It proves that surrounding intelligence and media depth are expected in the project category.
nadlan_response: NadLan showroom cannot be a visual shell. It needs project facts, media, map layers, nearby services, risks, source dates, and lead flow in one path.

observed_surface: Large urban-renewal guide covering process, cities, permits, and project types.
observed_strength: Strong guide/content footprint for informational real-estate intent.
visible_gap_or_limit: Guide pages alone do not create project lead ownership unless tied to city/project pages and professionals.
nadlan_response: Use guides as support pages with canonical internal links into city renewal hubs, project pages, and verified professionals.

observed_surface: Mortgage calculator with buyer purpose, property price, equity, loan period, and repayment simulation.
observed_strength: Banks set a high trust bar for calculators and disclosures.
visible_gap_or_limit: NadLan calculators must avoid pretending to provide binding financial advice.
nadlan_response: Build calculators as decision support with assumptions, disclaimers, source dates, lead routing, and professional follow-up.

observed_surface: English buying guide for apartment purchase process and professional consultation caution.
observed_strength: Strong English educational surface for aliyah and foreign buyers.
visible_gap_or_limit: It is not a project marketplace or unit-level conversion tool.
nadlan_response: NadLan English pages should combine education, project discovery, concierge intake, tax/legal disclaimers, and verified follow-up.

observed_surface: International Israel apartment search with filters, map, local currency, USD conversion, and many results.
observed_strength: Shows foreign-buyer expectation for map, currency, filters, and global marketplace familiarity.
visible_gap_or_limit: Generic international marketplace lacks local Hebrew project intelligence and contractor intake.
nadlan_response: Build EN pages with currency context, remote-buyer flow, project assets, local professional network, and source-gated claims.

observed_surface: Professional directory for real-estate lawyers with reviews, filtering, language/service options, WhatsApp and phone contact paths.
observed_strength: Strong professional trust and conversion mechanics.
visible_gap_or_limit: Directory logic is strong but not tied to property/project context.
nadlan_response: NadLan professionals should be tied to transaction stage, city, project, language, and verified status, not just a generic directory.

observed_surface: Appraiser directory with ratings, review counts, last-check status, phone contact, and locality.
observed_strength: Strong proof mechanics for trust and supplier selection.
visible_gap_or_limit: Category directory is not integrated into property decisions.
nadlan_response: NadLan should route appraisal, legal, mortgage, inspection, and design professionals from listing/project/tool contexts.
